# Test fixtures

Every fixture is synthetic or public. Nothing here comes from a person's own data.

| File | Made by or taken from | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `<file>` | `<the program and version that made it from made-up data, or the public corpus with its URL and commit>` | `<SPDX id>` |

Rules:

- Made-up people use names and addresses that cannot belong to a real person: `example.com`, `example.org` and
  `.test` domains, 555 phone numbers, and places of the public corpus you use.
- Paths in fixtures are relative. A fixture that needs an absolute home folder uses the made-up user name `user`
  in the home folder of the OS.
- Pictures carry no GPS position unless the test needs one; then the position is a public place.
